description:
Root-cause spike revised. The dirty prototype exposed a fundamental wrapper ABI split; it is not a landing candidate in its current shape.

Output contract
A constructed callable is one closure-target boundary. Its code is invoked as boxed public args, self, continuation; self owns exactly its physical captures. The harness extracts captures from self, produces logical capture/argument values for the wrapper body, selects a member using the producer-published dispatch plan, adapts member inputs/returns once, and invokes the caller continuation under the boundary's published logical return seam.

First loss
Construction wrappers are currently emitted as plain native functions with logical captures, args, cont parameters, but their addresses are installed in closure objects invoked as args, self, cont. The wrapper is absent from the closure-target registry, so codegen selects harness_plain_native rather than harness_closure_target. Self shifts into a logical parameter. Later continuation capture failures, raw/value return shifts, and carrier recoveries are downstream symptoms.

Authority
- CallableFlowEdge publishes producer capture mapping, member selection plan, target semantic layouts, and member return layouts.
- BackendConstructionWrapper is the only construction boundary contract.
- TransportLayout owns structural shape plus physical carrier presence.
- Executable input provenance may forward a construction identity only when unanimous; it selects the boundary and never reselects a target.
- Callsite return_flow owns adaptation from the boundary's stable logical result to the caller continuation.

Required redesign
1. Register every wrapper_fn as a NativeClosureTargetSurface derived directly from NativeCallableBoundary. Compile wrapper_fn with closure ABI and harness_closure_target.
2. Remove the plain-Direct wrapper ABI and all assumptions that wrapper captures are direct parameters.
3. Wrapper body receives logical capture/argument bindings only after the closure harness reads self; it selects/adapts members using published facts.
4. Publish one stable wrapper logical return seam. Member returns adapt once inside wrapper; caller-specific conversion lives in closure-call continuation adapter.
5. Collapse duplicated identity/return recovery: native variable boundary maps, interpreter FnId wrapper fallback, target-derived return position selection, and decode/materialize/re-encode chains that compensate for independently derived seams.

Proof
Range2, Range3 halt and suspend, scalar bridge, enum reducer/predicate, opaque escaped lambda, interpreter/native agreement, full cargo test --lib and deny-warning clippy. The scalar and Range regressions must be restored as tests; no first-member, universal direct target, or runtime helper workaround.

Temporary state
Read-only spike left a temporary FnId import/eprintln in native_codegen/function.rs. Remove it before any implementation/gates.
title: fz-k22: shared consumer bodies must dispatch closure calls through the VALUE-carried entry identity -- a static position->entry stamp is unrepresentable for type-variable arg slots
